clue.text: Insult for field artillery returning to the battleground

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the abbreviation for field artillery is read backwards

parts.note: FA is the abbreviation for field artillery
the front is where battle is fought

explanation.surface: Gunners go back to the front line, which someone takes as an insult.
explanation.definitionFit: An affront is a deliberate slight, the same as an insult offered openly.

clue.text: Bill gets accustomed to being on the defensive

parts.note: acc. is short for account, a bill
used to means accustomed to

explanation.surface: Someone who receives a bill is used to having to defend themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: The person charged in court must defend themselves, so the defendant is on the defensive.

clue.text: A taste low in popular esteem

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for low inside the word for esteem

parts.note: favour is approval or esteem in which one is held

explanation.surface: Someone with a liking for things held in low regard by the public.
explanation.definitionFit: Flavour is the distinctive savour of food, its taste.

clue.text: Oxygen layer in the atmosphere

parts.note: describes the triatomic form of the gas that forms a protective band high in the stratosphere

explanation.definitionFit: The gas O3 forms a band in the stratosphere that blocks ultraviolet light.

clue.text: Go to a boxing match, but look the other way

parts.note: a turn is a go, one's opportunity in a game
a bout is a fight in the ring

explanation.surface: A fan attends a fight but cannot bear to watch the punches.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnabout is a reversal of direction, facing or looking the opposite way.

clue.text: Cheerful French fryer

definitions.meaning: an informal word for bright and lively
a pan or appliance that fries chips (French fries) is a chip fryer

explanation.definitionFit: Lively and bright in mood is one sense; the other is a device or shop worker that cooks chips.

clue.text: When in California Violet has carp

indicators.note: in places the short form of Violet inside California's abbreviation

parts.note: Vi is a short form of the name Violet

explanation.surface: A woman named Violet visiting California keeps a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to complain over trifles, which is to raise petty objections.

clue.text: When I sent letters out, it hit the headlines!

indicators.note: the letters are let out and set free to form a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone's mailshot goes out and becomes a newspaper sensation.
explanation.definitionFit: Featured in current reporting, as a story is when it makes headline news.

clue.text: Fails to get a food hamper

definitions.meaning: an engine or machine that ... breaks down
read as pack of sup, a pack for supper, a bundle of food

explanation.definitionFit: Stops working is the idiom; humorously split, it is a pack for a meal like a picnic hamper.

clue.text: It curls right around the fireplace

annotationWithheld.why: It curls right around the fireplace: R + INGLE gives RINGLE and nothing supplies the final T (IT around RINGLE gives IRINGLET); likely clue garbled or a setter slip
annotationWithheld.clue: It curls right around the fireplace

clue.text: Love affair after class causes an outcry

indicators.note: after places the love affair behind the abbreviation for class in the answer

parts.note: cl. is the standard abbreviation for class
an amour is a love affair, especially a secret one

explanation.surface: A romance between classmates sets tongues wagging and causes a public stir.
explanation.definitionFit: A clamour is a loud protest or demand, an outcry from many voices.

clue.text: Tax I am empowered to obtain from church capital

parts.note: VAT is value added tax
can means am able, am empowered to do something

explanation.surface: A tax collector claims authority to take money from the church's funds.
explanation.definitionFit: Vatican City is the seat of the Roman Catholic Church, its capital in a sense.

clue.text: Jackson is to hinder proceedings

definitions.meaning: the Confederate general Thomas Jackson was nicknamed ...
to block a debate or inquiry by delay and evasion

explanation.definitionFit: General Thomas Jackson won the nickname at Bull Run; as a verb it means obstruct by evasive tactics.

clue.text: A supporter of art

parts.note: reads like a patron of the arts, but means a stand that literally holds up a painting

explanation.definitionFit: A painter's easel is a frame that holds a canvas upright, literally supporting the work.

clue.text: Gold I used in current architectural style

indicators.note: used in tells us the gold and I are placed inside the current

parts.note: DC is direct current
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Gold leaf applied to electrical work as a design choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Doric is one of the classical orders of Greek columns, plain and sturdy.

clue.text: Young animal near the burrow is snug

parts.note: a cub is a young fox, bear or lion
by means near or beside
a hole is an animal's burrow

explanation.surface: A fox cub nestled beside its den is cosy.
explanation.definitionFit: A snug is a small cosy room, just as a cubbyhole is a small enclosed space.

clue.text: Where dermatological cream must be applied immediately

definitions.text: Where dermatological cream must be applied
definitions.meaning: skin cream goes straight onto the blemish, the place affected

explanation.definitionFit: A pimple ointment goes right on the blemish; the idiom also means at once, there and then.

clue.text: Boon companion of the young Roosevelt

definitions.text: Boon companion of the young Roosevelt

parts.words: Boon companion of the young Roosevelt
parts.note: read as a friend of the youthful president, but means a children's toy named after President Theodore Roosevelt

explanation.definitionFit: The stuffed toy was named after President Theodore Roosevelt and is a child's constant companion.

clue.text: Lived together, as is the practice in a mixed school

indicators.note: in places the practice inside the mixed school

parts.note: a co-ed is a coeducational school, for boys and girls
a habit is a regular practice

explanation.surface: Sharing a home together, as is customary at a coeducational school.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohabit is to share a home as a couple, so lived together fits.

clue.text: Narcotic film about South American plant

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the film wraps around the plant

parts.note: cine is film, as in cine camera
oca is an Andean plant grown for its tubers

explanation.surface: A documentary about a plant from the Andes.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites COCA, the drug's source, but the plant is OCA, an Andean tuber crop.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocaine is an addictive drug extracted from coca leaves, classed in law as a narcotic.

clue.text: Henry goes to a shady retreat for shelter

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
an arbour is a shady garden bower

explanation.surface: Henry retreats to a leafy bower for protection.
explanation.definitionFit: To harbour is to give refuge, and a harbour is a place of shelter for ships.

clue.text: A change of underclothing

definitions.meaning: a change of position or direction
a simple slip or chemise worn under a dress

explanation.definitionFit: A move or alteration is one sense; a loose undergarment, a chemise, is the other.

clue.text: Appropriate suggestion of purpose

definitions.meaning: proper or acceptable, as in a remark being allowed
the phrase introduces an aim, as in doing something so as to achieve it

explanation.definitionFit: Proper and acceptable is one sense; as the start of the phrase in order to, it signals intention.

clue.text: He enters party resolved to provide health care

indicators.note: enters means goes inside, so the pronoun goes into the rearranged letters
resolved read as broken down and reworked, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A man joins a political party determined to deliver medical services.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' turns PARTY into TRAPY; 'enters' puts HE after its T.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is treatment for illness or disorder, a form of health care.

clue.text: Transport by road and rail

parts.note: a car is the vehicle that travels by road
RY is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A freight company moving goods by road and rail.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry is to convey goods from place to place, a verb for transport.

clue.text: Mayor's one resolve is to forget it

indicators.note: resolve read as re-solve, to work out again, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the letters of mayor with its S kept
taken as written

explanation.surface: A mayor declares his single aim is to put the matter behind him.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dismissive idioms telling someone to drop the subject, no need for more words.

clue.text: Newspaper man is in position

indicators.note: is in places the man inside the word for position

parts.note: set means positioned or placed
he is a man, a male

explanation.surface: A journalist takes up his post at the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheet is informal for a newspaper, especially a cheap one, as in a scandal sheet.

clue.text: Nothing given to invalid is like an egg

parts.note: O is the figure zero, nothing
void means null and invalid, as of a contract

explanation.surface: A sick patient gets nothing to eat but an egg-shaped meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Ovoid means egg-shaped, from the Latin for egg.

clue.text: Is Poe to conjure up an elemental form?

indicators.note: to conjure up is to make something appear by magic, so the letters are transformed

explanation.surface: A question whether Edgar Allan Poe will summon some elemental spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Atoms of one element with different neutron counts are its varieties, each an elemental form.

clue.text: Introductions enable former soldiers to get reciprocal help

parts.note: ex means former
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: reciprocal suggests going back the other way, so the help is read backwards

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Veterans are introduced to one another so they can offer mutual assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Exordium is a formal word for the opening of a speech or treatise, a preamble or introduction.

clue.text: Sincere pledge

definitions.meaning: a token payment made to bind a bargain

explanation.definitionFit: Serious in intention is one sense; a deposit given as a guarantee of good faith is the other.

clue.text: Embarrassed the Soviet military

parts.note: red, as in red-faced from embarrassment
an army is a land military force

explanation.surface: Soviet generals left humiliated after a setback.
explanation.walkthrough: RED also hints at Soviet communism, so the colour serves the definition too.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet Union's land forces were called the Red Army after the communist colour.
